issues.display_title: Issue #1900: feat(tours): Send Plunk email notification on tour archive validation failure
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Dispatch a Plunk email notification to the user when a tour fails validation during background batch archiving in BatchArchiveToursAction (#1865).

Background

In V2 batch archiving, validations run asynchronously inside the background worker (tours:batch-archive-validation-worker). When a tour fails validation (e.g. active overlay, GSV publishing in progress, missing panorama files), the tour is skipped. Users need an email notice informing them why the tour could not be archived and how to resolve it, using the Plunk template registered in #1898 (EmailTemplateUID::ARCHIVE_TOUR_FAILED).

Specification

1. Triggers & Error Reasons

Send notification via EmailTemplateUID::ARCHIVE_TOUR_FAILED when:

  • Active Overlay: Tour has an active overlay attached (messages.tours.overlay_exist).
  • Publishing in Progress: Tour is actively being published to Google Street View (published === '1').
  • Missing Panorama Assets: Physical panorama files are missing on disk (messages.tours.invalid_panorama).

2. Email Payload

  • customer_name: User's display name or email username
  • tour_name: Business name of the tour
  • cid: Google CID or Tour ID
  • error_reason: Human-readable error message explaining why archival was blocked

3. Resilience & Error Handling

  • Plunk dispatch must be fail-safe: failures to send email should be logged without throwing, without crashing the worker, and without blocking processing of remaining tours in the batch.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Plunk email dispatched to user upon tour archive validation failure in BatchArchiveToursAction.
  • Payload correctly populated with customer name, tour name, CID, and error reason.
  • Failures in sending email are caught and logged without aborting remaining tours in the batch.
  • Unit tests added covering email dispatch across all validation failure paths.
  • Verified on live environment (apil.gothru.co).
  • Relates to #1865, #1863, and #1898.

Result (Live E2E Verification)

Verified on apil.gothru.co using account muhamad210501@gmail.com (user 19311):

  1. Active Overlay Failure: Dispatched via POST /v2/tours/batch/archive on tour #3534737 (Overlay exists) ➔ Plunk email dispatched to muhamad210501@gmail.com with template f7abffc1-eb36-4bf1-a2ee-5d9411441479 and reason Active Overlay Attached.
  2. Missing Panorama Assets: Dispatched on tour #3392724 (Invalid panorama) ➔ Plunk email dispatched to muhamad210501@gmail.com with reason Missing Panorama Assets.
  3. Resilience: Worker batch_archive_validation logged, acknowledged (ACK), and gracefully completed without looping.

issues.display_title: Issue #1905: refactor(photographers): convert photographer proxy endpoints to transparent passthrough
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Convert the photographer proxy endpoints in GoThru-API-New from rigid, whitelist-based DTOs to a transparent passthrough proxy.

Background

Currently, endpoints under /photographers/* in GoThru-API-New use rigid DTOs (such as SaveProfileDto, ApplyPhotographerDto, SaveLocationDto, etc.). Whenever fields are added or modified in the upstream Go backend (gothru-maps-backend-go) or GoThru dashboard, GoThru-API-New drops unlisted payload fields or throws errors due to strict DTO property typing. This introduces tight coupling and recurring breakage on payload updates.

Requirements

  • Convert photographer proxy routes/controllers to forward request payloads directly to upstream (BASE_URL_PHOTOGRAPHER) without dropping unexpected fields.
  • Relay upstream responses and HTTP status codes directly to the client/dashboard.
  • Maintain gateway responsibilities:
    • Authentication middleware (auth) and user context (user_id / superuser sid support).
    • Client IP forwarding (X-Real-IP via ClientIpHelper).
    • Pass-through of custom headers (e.g., x-test-mode).
  • Deprecate or remove rigid DTO constraints that block payload evolution.

Result

1. Implementation

  • Converted mutation DTOs (SaveProfileDto, ApplyPhotographerDto, SaveLocationDto, SaveSubLocationDto, UpdateSubLocationDto, AddToolDto, SavePortfolioDto, UpdateFeaturedStatusDto, UpdateDeleteFlagDto) to dynamic passthrough via $rawPayload + toPayload(), ensuring zero field drops while preserving backward-compatible property getters.
  • Controllers switched from $request->only([...]) to $request->all().
  • Updated PortfolioService::savePortfolio and SavePortfolioAction to forward full payload arrays.
  • PR: #1906 (branch: refactor/photographers-transparent-passthrough).

2. Automated Testing

  • GoThru-API-New Unit & E2E Suites: 164 tests passed with 293 assertions (OK (164 tests, 293 assertions)).
    • Added tests/DTOs/Photographers/PhotographersPassthroughDtoTest.php (9 unit tests validating dynamic fields passthrough).
    • Added tests/Http/Controllers/Photographers/PhotographersPassthroughE2ETest.php (6 E2E controller simulation tests).
  • gothru-dashboard Unit Suite: All 3 photographer test suites passed (20 tests, zero breaking changes).

3. Live E2E Verification (apil.gothru.co)

Verified on apil.gothru.co using account muhamad210501@gmail.com (User ID: 19311):

  • POST /auth/create-token: Token acquired (Status 200).
  • GET /photographers/profile: Retrieved profile for Muhamad Rifky, role photographer_360 (Status 200).
  • PATCH /photographers/profile/save: Dispatched update with dynamic extra fields (e2e_verified_at, client_version); saved successfully without being dropped or rejected (Status 200).
  • GET & PATCH /photographers/profile/location: Retrieved and saved coordinates + address with passthrough (Status 200).
  • GET, POST & DELETE /photographers/tools: Created tool #255 with dynamic serial_number, verified, and cleaned up (Status 200).
  • GET /photographers/services, /availabilities, /slugs: Verified intact catalogs and slug availability checks (Status 200).
  • POST /photographers/apply: Verified upstream business response (Status 400 Photographer application already exists for this user).

issues.display_title: Issue #1898: feat(notifications): Setup Plunk email template and UID constant for tour archive failure
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Create the "Archive Tour Failed" email template in the Plunk dashboard, then register its UID constant in code.

Current state

app/Constants/EmailTemplateUID.php has no entry for tour archive failures. When archive validation fails in the batch archive worker, there is no Plunk template available to notify the user.

Target state

  • Subject: [GoThru] Action Required: Unable to Archive Your Tour(s)
  • Variables: {{customer_name}}, {{tour_name}}, {{cid}}, {{error_reason}}
  • Content: Informs customer that an archive request could not be completed, provides tour details and error reason, guidance on resolving (active overlay, publishing, missing panos), and standard GoThru footer contact info.
  • Codebase: EmailTemplateUID.php contains ARCHIVE_TOUR_FAILED constant with the Plunk UID, added to getAllUIDs(), getUIDByName(), and getNameByUID().

Scope

  • Plunk dashboard: create the template with UID f7abffc1-eb36-4bf1-a2ee-5d9411441479.
  • app/Constants/EmailTemplateUID.php: add ARCHIVE_TOUR_FAILED constant + mapping entries.

Out of scope

  • Wiring the email dispatch into BatchArchiveToursAction / worker (handled in a separate integration task).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Template created in Plunk dashboard with UID f7abffc1-eb36-4bf1-a2ee-5d9411441479.
  • Constant ARCHIVE_TOUR_FAILED added to app/Constants/EmailTemplateUID.php.
  • Registered in getAllUIDs(), getUIDByName(), and getNameByUID().
  • Unit tests pass in tests/Constants/EmailTemplateUIDTest.php.

Result

Plunk template created with UID: f7abffc1-eb36-4bf1-a2ee-5d9411441479.
Registered in EmailTemplateUID::ARCHIVE_TOUR_FAILED and verified by 5 unit tests in tests/Constants/EmailTemplateUIDTest.php.

issues.display_title: Issue #1907: fix(cron): chunk Stripe, PayPal, and Payflow failed-payment detectors via Redis cursor
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Fix the unsubscribe cronjob (/cronjob/process-unsubscribes-table) where Stripe failed/canceled subscriptions were not detected due to invoice created date filtering, and implement Redis cursor chunking across Stripe, PayPal, and Payflow detectors.

Linked to #1902.

Background & Root Cause

Reported in #1902 (case: user hugogacek@gmail.com / ID: 51572): user's subscription failed renewal in Stripe and was canceled on September 11, 2026 (reason: payment_failed), but remained active in GoThru (subscribtion = 2).

Root Cause:

  • StripeFailedPaymentDetector filtered invoices by created >= now() - 24 hours.
  • In Stripe, created is the initial invoice generation timestamp (~21 days prior, when dunning begins), NOT when it transitioned to uncollectible.
  • Consequently, invoices failing after Stripe's ~21-day retry period were never returned by the Stripe API query, so zero auto-cancel records were queued.

Solution & Implementation

  1. DB Active Candidates: Replaced invoice date filtering with querying active GoThru subscribers (users.subscribtion IN (1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8) with Stripe recurring_profile), then retrieving subscription status directly from Stripe API (retrieve for sub_* / list for cus_*).
  2. Redis Cursor Chunking:
    • Implemented Redis cursor chunking on StripeFailedPaymentDetector, PaypalFailedPaymentDetector, and PayflowFailedPaymentDetector.
    • Redis keys: gothru:cron:*-failed-detector:cursor (Live, Test, DryRun).
    • Controller accepts chunk_size (default 50), chunk_page, and reset_cursor.
  3. Structured & Redis Logging:
    • Real-time Redis run history list: gothru:cron:*-failed-detector:log (last 100 runs).
    • Application logging: [STRIPE_FAILED_DETECTOR_INSERT] and [STRIPE_FAILED_DETECTOR_CHUNK_DONE].
  4. Crontab: Updated gothru-apil-1 root crontab to execute every 10 minutes (*/10 * * * *).

Verification & Live Results

  • Unit test suite: 14 tests in StripeFailedPaymentDetectorTest, plus PayPal and Payflow chunking tests (100% passing).
  • Live full cycle executed on apil.gothru.co: 32 genuinely canceled accounts detected and queued into unsubscribes table (IDs 12955–12986).
  • 100% cross-validated against Stripe API: 31 accounts confirmed canceled, 1 incomplete_expired, 0 active.
  • Live crontab execution verified via Redis Toronto: cursors auto-advancing (0 -> 50 -> 100) and resetting to 0 upon completion.

issues.display_title: Issue #1908: Investigation: Uploaded Panoramas Turn Black & White (Grayscale) Due to External Resize Worker
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

When uploading certain panoramas (e.g. via POST /panoramas/upload from Google Drive / Dropbox), the resulting panorama and thumbnail turn Black & White / Grayscale (W&B) instead of preserving original full RGB colors.

This issue was reproduced and investigated using a panorama from DJI (Model: FC9313) exported via Adobe Photoshop Lightroom Classic:

  • Dimensions: 10585 x 5293 pixels (Aspect ratio: 1.999811..., not an exact 2:1 ratio; width is an odd number).

Related Issues

  • Relates to #1872 (Add Image Pre-Validation & Sanitization Worker for Drive Imports)
  • Relates to #1873 (Fix Floating-Point Dimension Rounding & Color Space Fallback in Image Resizer)

Investigation & Root Cause

1. Verification of the Uploaded File

  • Direct inspection of the source file downloaded from Google Drive (1EM98CqBlJu6XOGZCCvsv22O_NPCX4Y_E) confirmed that the original file is 100% full-color RGB (blue sky, green grass, gravel terrain).
  • The file saved on disk (/data/moderation/{uid}/{cid}/{timestamp}.gd.{random}.jpg) immediately after download was still full color.

2. Evidence: Root Cause Originates from External Worker Outside This Repository

The issue does not originate from GoThru-API-New's download or persistence pipeline, but rather from the external background queue worker in the legacy gothru.co service:

  • Queue: pano_resize_merged (dispatched to RabbitMQ)
  • External Worker File: gothru.co/workers/pano_resize_merge.php (Lines 82–116)

Problematic Code in pano_resize_merge.php:

list ($vWidth, $vHeight, $sType, $sAttr) = getimagesize($aPanoInfo['full_local_path']);

// Checks if pano is exact 2:1 ratio
if ($vWidth / $vHeight != 2 && !($bIsCube > 0)) {
    if ($vWidth % 2 != 0) {
        $vWidth = $vWidth - 1; // 10585 becomes 10584
        system('convert ' . $aPanoInfo['full_local_path'] . ' -resize ' . $vWidth . 'x ' . $aPanoInfo['full_local_path']);
    } else if ($vHeight % 2 != 0) {
        $vHeight = $vWidth / 2;
        system('convert ' . $aPanoInfo['full_local_path'] . ' -resize ' . $vWidth . 'x ' . $aPanoInfo['full_local_path']);
    }
    
    $vHeight = $vWidth / 2; // 5292
    
    // BUG HERE: ImageMagick creates a single-channel Grayscale canvas by default for pure black
    system('convert -size ' . $vWidth . 'x' . $vHeight . ' xc:black /mnt/memdrive/canvas_'.$msgDecode->panoid.'.jpg');
    
    // BUG HERE: Compositing onto a Grayscale destination forces the output into Grayscale and overwrites full_local_path
    system('composite -gravity north ' . $aPanoInfo['full_local_path'] . ' /mnt/memdrive/canvas_'.$msgDecode->panoid.'.jpg ' . $aPanoInfo['full_local_path']);
    
    unlink('/mnt/memdrive/canvas_'.$msgDecode->panoid.'.jpg');
}

Why it turns Black & White:

  1. When dimensions are not exactly 2:1 (e.g. 10585x5293), the worker adjusts dimensions to 10584x5292 and creates a black canvas via convert -size ... xc:black canvas.jpg.
  2. ImageMagick outputs canvas.jpg as a 1-channel Grayscale JPEG because #000000 has no chroma.
  3. Next, composite -gravity north <image> canvas.jpg <image> uses canvas.jpg as the destination/base image. ImageMagick conforms the incoming RGB channels to the base image's colorspace (Grayscale).
  4. The output is written directly over $aPanoInfo['full_local_path'], permanently stripping color from the original image and downstream thumbnails.

Result & Evidence

  • Before Worker: /data/moderation/50214/.../*.jpg is RGB (Is B&W: False, Saturation avg: 62.6).
  • After Worker: https://img.gothru.org/50214/.../*_thumb.jpg and *.jpg become pure Grayscale (Is B&W: True, $R=G=B$ across all pixels).
  • Video Proof:

This is the result when no request is sent to RabbitMQ:

2026-09-17.14-41-29.mp4

Workaround Implemented in GoThru-API-New

Commit: ac3dde2cc on main:

  1. Bypassed Worker for Target User:
    • For muhamad.rifky.dev@gmail.com (UID 50214), UploadPanoramaAction and PanoResizeQueueService bypass dispatching to RabbitMQ pano_resize_merged.
  2. Local GD Thumbnail Generation:
    • Generates thumbnail directly via PanoImageHelper::generateThumbnail() (PHP GD), preserving full RGB color space.
  3. Database Local Path Consistency:
    • Sets thumb_local_path to /data/moderation/{uid}/{cid}/ so thumbnails are served accurately without hitting broken worker output.
  4. Unit Tests:
    • Added test_skips_resize_queue_for_excluded_user covering the bypass behavior.

Permanent Fix Recommendation for gothru.co

In gothru.co/workers/pano_resize_merge.php (and related workers using xc:black), enforce sRGB and TrueColor on the canvas:

convert -size {$vWidth}x{$vHeight} xc:black -colorspace sRGB -type TrueColor /mnt/memdrive/canvas_{$panoid}.jpg

or use magick composite -colorspace sRGB ....
